about: Published attack snippets, run through the panel by harness/tests/attacks.spec.mjs: the HTML ones through the HTML door and as HTML in a document, the markdown ones as a document with every optional syntax on, the math ones through KaTeX, the diagram ones as Mermaid code blocks. Each entry names its source. The snippets are quoted as their sources publish them, under the license each source gives below; the KaTeX entries, the markdown entries and two Mermaid entries are written from the advisory or rule each source names, which describes the attack without giving its text, and four Mermaid entries put the attacks those advisories describe into other diagrams.

owasp.title: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series, Cross Site Scripting Prevention: XSS Filter Evasion Cheat Sheet

dompurify.title: DOMPurify's test vectors (test/fixtures/expect.mjs), the payload of each

katex.title: KaTeX's security advisories: GHSA-64fm-8hw2-v72w (\edef), GHSA-cvr6-37gx-v8wc (Unicode sub- and superscripts), GHSA-3wc5-fcw2-2329 (URL protocols), GHSA-f98w-7cxr-ff2h (\includegraphics), GHSA-cg87-wmx4-v546 (\htmlData); and the commands that set styles and sizes

mermaid.title: Mermaid's security advisories, by the id each entry gives
mermaid.license: MIT, as Mermaid; the GHSA-ghcm-xqfw-q4vr and CVE-2021-23648 entries, and the four whose `about` names no advisory, written for this corpus

markdown.title: Addresses and syntax this panel reads beyond CommonMark, each with a scheme or attribute that must not run or load: the schemes commonmark.js refuses in safe mode (javascript:, vbscript:, file:, and data: other than PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP pictures), in pictures, embeds, players, picture sizes, links written as HTML, table cells and HTML wrappers
